'''2001 FreedomCon side tournament (16 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG side event held at Sheraton Oceanfront Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia on 16 November 2001. It is known from Jeremy Oakes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3123">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-26-kashyyyk-in-virginia-beach-part-iid3123/ kashyyyk-in-virginia-beach-part-ii], DeckTech (Jeremy "JerUNH" Oakes, 26 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-26-kashyyyk-in-virginia-beach-part-iid3123/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Decipher World Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 16 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Sheraton Oceanfront Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
